description: This is an HTML source file that defines the structure, styles, and client-side logic for a web-based database visualizer interface, including database and table selection, data display, and interactive elements.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database entries to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
